### 🎯 Task Description
Clear and concise description of the task or improvement.

### 🏠 Target Sovereign House or Subsystem
- [ ] 01 The Security House (`skills/security-house/`)
- [ ] 02 The Dev House (`skills/dev-house/`)
- [ ] 03 The Media House (`skills/media-house/`)
- [ ] 04 Ops & Tokens (`skills/ops-tokens-house/`)
- [ ] 05 The Design House (`skills/design-house/`)
- [ ] 06 The Intel House (`skills/intel-house/`)
- [ ] 07 The Growth House (`skills/growth-house/`)
- [ ] Core Engine / CLI (`scripts/`)
- [ ] Documentation / Benchmarks (`docs/`, `BENCHMARKS.md`, `GLOSSARY.md`)

### 📋 Prerequisites & Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Code/skill adheres to zero-slop standards (no placeholder stubs, no marketing buzzwords).
- [ ] Pre-commit check passes: `workshop court trial --staged`.
- [ ] Manifest updated if adding/modifying skills: `python scripts/workshop_skills.py`.
- [ ] Unit tests pass: `pytest tests`.

### 💡 Guidance & Resources
Reference materials, examples (see `examples/`), or existing runbooks to model from.
